info.title: GitHub public REST API (MCPForge showcase)
info.description: Real, keyless endpoints usable within unauthenticated rate limits, and commonly called by developers. They cover a complete agent workflow: probe reachability → search by topic → pull concrete metrics to decide. They drive the full MCPForge Build → Verify → MCPize → Monetize chain and support a real task, “produce a technology selection brief”, which depends on live star and issue data that a prompt cannot fabricate.

get.description: Returns a short design motto, used for liveness and connectivity self-checks.
Returns the API rate limit for the current IP, which an agent uses to decide whether to back off.
Returns public events across the network; an agent uses them for activity monitoring and trend awareness.

Returns repositories matching the keywords, including star counts and descriptions. This is the first step of a technology selection investigation, and because results track the real world, a prompt cannot answer from memory.

get.description: Returns live metrics for one repository: stars, forks, open issues, primary language, and last update time. An agent uses it to verify candidates instead of trusting stale search summaries.
